name: Chimera no Kenpin Arbeit
original_name: キメラの検品アルバイト
source:
In the future, where science and technology have advanced, you've been hired to work part-time at a certain laboratory.
It seems like a simple job, just rejecting defective products, but it seems like these products are special?
Spend three days working and chatting with the long-haired man and genius girl who live at the laboratory!
